# V2.1 development experiments (auto-generated by src/v2/run_v21.py)

Dev file only; **2025/2026 not read**. Selection folds 2020-2022 (all choices), reporting folds 2023-2024 (held out from V2.1 choices, **not independent**). Same matches for every model. `vs_V2` = log loss minus full V2's on the reporting folds, 95% tournament-bootstrap interval.

## 2. Recalibration (fitted on 2020-2022 predictions, scored on 2023-2024)

Platt slope < 1 means the raw model was overconfident on the fitting years. Adopt only if the interval is entirely below 0.

## 4. Does statistical form show up before Elo moves? (descriptive, 2015-2023)

Ordinary least squares on 47,591 player-match rows: each player's general Elo change over the next 90 days against pre-match inputs. Rows of one player overlap in time, so t-values are optimistic; read signs and sizes, not significance.

| input (standardised) | effect on next-90-day Elo change (/400) | t |
|---|---|---|
| intercept | +0.0229 | +49.3 |
| pq20 | +0.0020 | +3.6 |
| luck10 | -0.0171 | -33.2 |
| pq_trend | +0.0035 | +7.1 |
| elo_trend | +0.0027 | +4.6 |
